1.ar: وَلَا تَهِنُوا وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا وَأَنتُمُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
1.en: "So do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are [true] believers."
"Your Lord has not forsaken you, nor is He displeased."

1.ar: إِنَّمَا أَشْكُو بَثِّي وَحُزْنِي إِلَى اللَّهِ
1.en: "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah."

1.ar: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلَاةِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ
1.en: "O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient."

2.ar: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
2.en: "Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear."

2.ar: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ
2.en: "Say, 'O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allah.'"

2.ar: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
2.en: "And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him."

2.ar: مَا أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِن بِاللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُ
2.en: "No disaster strikes except by permission of Allah. And whoever believes in Allah - He will guide his heart."

2.ar: وَإِن تَوَلَّوْا فَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ مَوْلَاكُمْ ۚ نِعْمَ الْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ النَّصِيرُ
2.en: "And if they turn away - then know that Allah is your protector. Excellent is the protector, and Excellent is the helper."

3.ar: الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَتَطْمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ ۗ أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
3.en: "Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allah. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured."
"And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life]."
"Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth."

3.ar: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ
3.en: "And when My servants ask you, [O Muhammad], concerning Me - indeed I am near."

4.ar: وَإِذْ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمْ لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ
4.en: "And [remember] when your Lord proclaimed, 'If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favor].'"
"Is the reward for good [anything] but good?"

4.ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ
4.en: "Indeed, those who have said, 'Our Lord is Allah' and then remained on a right course - the angels will descend upon them..."

4.ar: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
4.en: "So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me."

5.ar: يَا أَيَّتُهَا النَّفْسُ الْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ ارْجِعِي إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً
5.en: "[To the righteous it will be said], 'O reassured soul, Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him].'"
"[And] 'Peace,' a word from a Merciful Lord."

5.ar: وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
5.en: "And He is with you wherever you are. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing."

5.ar: أَلَا إِنَّ أَوْلِيَاءَ اللَّهِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
5.en: "Unquestionably, [for] the allies of Allah there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve."
